# YAVSOS settings

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/settings_doc.py from src/YAVSOS/Configuration/PluginSettings.cs.
Do not edit by hand: change a setting's description in the code and run the script. -->

Every setting YAVSOS has, as the configuration manager shows it. Change them in game with a
configuration manager (F1 with BepInEx ConfigurationManager), or in
`BepInEx/config/com.bastionntb.yavsos.cfg`.

**Who sets what.** On a server with YAVSOS, the server decides everything under **Server**,
and its categories file applies to everyone. While `LockSharedPolicy` is on, only admins can
change those. Everything under **Cleanup**, **Stash** and **Controls** is each player's own.
Single-player and client-only games use your own file for all of them.

**With AzuAutoStore.** AzuAutoStore does the stashing with its own keys, range and hotbar
settings, so the **Stash** settings are read-only and kept for when it's removed, and
`AllowStashing` has no effect. `MaximumRange` and `MaximumChests` then limit cleanup only.
Cleanup is Ctrl plus AzuAutoStore's store key.

## Server

Set by the server.

| Setting | Default | Allowed | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AllowCleanup` | on | — | Allow players to run misplaced-item cleanup. Set by the server. |
| `AllowStashing` | on | — | Allow players to stash with YAVSOS's store keys. With AzuAutoStore installed, its own store key stashes and this has no effect. Set by the server. |
| `LockSharedPolicy` | on | — | Lock shared settings for nonadministrators. ServerSync permissions apply; this grants no chest access. |
| `MaximumChests` | 256 | 16–256 | Most chests one cleanup or YAVSOS stash looks at, the nearest first; the result says when more were in range. With AzuAutoStore installed, its store key searches chests itself, so this then limits cleanup only. Set by the server. |
| `MaximumRange` | 50 m | 1–100 m | Largest range in metres a player may use for cleanup and for YAVSOS's own stash. With AzuAutoStore installed, its store key uses its own range, so this then limits cleanup only. Set by the server. |

## Cleanup

Your own.

| Setting | Default | Allowed | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Range` | 10 m | 1–100 m | How far from you, in metres, cleanup looks for chests. Capped by the server's MaximumRange. |
| `Shortcut` | Ctrl + . | — | Runs cleanup of nearby chests when AzuAutoStore is not installed. With AzuAutoStore, cleanup is Ctrl plus AzuAutoStore's own store key. |

## Stash

Your own.

| Setting | Default | Allowed | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IncludeHotbar` | off | — | Also store items from your hotbar (the first inventory row), with the store key and the single-item key. Equipped and quest items are never stored. Used only without AzuAutoStore, which applies its own "Player Ignore Hotbar". |
| `IncludeQuickSlots` | off | — | Also store items from AzuExtendedPlayerInventory's quick slots, with the store key and the single-item key. Used only without AzuAutoStore, which always keeps them. |
| `Range` | 10 m | 1–100 m | How far from you, in metres, the stash key looks for chests. Capped by the server's MaximumRange. Used only without AzuAutoStore. |
| `Shortcut` | . | — | Stores items from your inventory into nearby chests whose rules accept them, and into unruled chests that already hold them. Used only without AzuAutoStore. |
| `SingleItemShortcut` | Middle mouse | — | With your inventory open, stores the stack under the mouse into nearby chests. Used only without AzuAutoStore. |

## Controls

Your own.

| Setting | Default | Allowed | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HighlightSecondsAfterClose` | 20 | 0–60 | After you close a chest, how many seconds the chests lit by its search stay lit, so you can walk to them. 0 turns them off when the chest closes. While the search is active they stay lit. |
| `PanelOffsetX` | 0 | — | Rule panel offset to the right of its place beside the chest window, in the game's UI units (1080p-scaled); negative moves it left. Drag the panel's title to change it, for example if it overlaps another mod's window. |
| `PanelOffsetY` | 0 | — | Rule panel offset downwards from the top of the chest window, in the game's UI units (1080p-scaled); negative moves it up. |
| `ShowChestLabels` | on | — | Add the chest's rule to its hover text, such as "Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)". Only chests with a rule that you can open. |
| `ShowItemCategories` | on | — | Add an item's categories to its tooltip, such as "Raw food, Animal feed · eaten by Boar, Hen". |
| `ShowResultPanel` | on | — | After a cleanup, or a stash with YAVSOS's own store keys (without AzuAutoStore), show a short result panel with what moved and what stayed, with item names and reasons. |
| `ShowRuleControls` | on | — | Show the chest rule panel while a chest is open. |
